title: The Mystery of the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact
next_chapter_hook: Just as the light emanating from the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact gradually subsided, a dazzling golden radiance abruptly blazed from the depths of the heavens, as if something in the distant celestial realm was gazing upon this place...

text.content: The void of the Cosmic Eye violently trembled, and Cang Yutian's furious voice thundered like a sudden clap of thunder beside everyone's ears. 'You are playing with fire!' Chen Ji stood at the storm's center, his dark robes billowing in the wind, yet his face showed no trace of fear. He lowered his gaze to the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact in his palm—the originally dim patterns were now visibly spreading with golden light. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the first page, his voice uncharacteristically grave: 'It has awakened.'

Cracks spread across the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact's surface like a spider's web, each fissure bursting forth with brilliant starlight. This was no ordinary radiance—it carried the aura of some primordial law. Everyone present felt their cultivation suppressed by a force of higher dimension. Han Lie's knees buckled, nearly collapsing to the ground, his face filled with unimaginable horror. Cang Yutian's phantom twisted in the distance, as if bearing some immense backlash. 'Impossible... How could this thing awaken at this moment!' His voice no longer carried its previous fury, replaced by bone-deep fear.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form drifted to Chen Ji's side, his voice low and solemn: 'Ten thousand years ago, the passage between the celestial realm and the mortal world had not yet been completely severed. This Turtle Shell Divine Artifact was originally a fragment of the 'Heavenly Eye' used by the immortal realm to observe the mortal domain. Its abandonment in the mortal realm was no accident—it was deliberately arranged.' He paused, his gaze deep as he stared at the faintly visible fissure at the artifact's core. 'Sealed within is an ancient passage leading to the celestial realm.'

text.content: The Turtle Shell Divine Artifact's glow reached an unprecedented peak, with countless intricate symbols peeling away from its surface and weaving into an enormous star map in the air. That star chart distinctly displayed the outline of nine celestial tiers, and at its highest point, a golden gate was gradually emerging. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center, and the Tianji Record Fragment automatically turned its pages—the three-hour foresight ability was somehow activating on its own. He witnessed the celestial gate swing wide open, countless figures pouring out, the continent beneath his feet reduced to scorched earth in an instant. Then he saw... Chen Nian's hollow eyes staring directly at him.

dialogue.content: At this moment, a mournful, ethereal sigh drifted from the depths of the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact. That voice carried an otherworldly sorrow, as if traversing countless years: 'Brother... you've finally found it.' Chen Ji recoiled, his gaze drawn to a translucent maiden's form materializing within the artifact—precisely his long-lost sister Chen Nian's silhouette. Her figure flickered in and out of visibility, suggesting some profound connection to the divine object. 'Nian'er! What are you doing here?' Chen Ji uncharacteristically lost his composure, stepping forward. The maiden only shook her head with a bitter smile: 'I've been waiting for you from the very beginning. Only you can prevent what's about to unfold... but the price may be one neither of us can bear.'

text.content: Cang Yutian's roar shattered this uncanny reunion: 'Chen Ji! You have no idea what you're truly unleashing! Once that gate fully opens, the celestial will brand you as a betrayer, and then—' His voice cut off abruptly as a golden bolt of lightning descended from the heavens, shattering his phantom into fragments. The will of the Heavenly Eye seemed to warn any force attempting interference. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded once more: 'The gate has opened a crack. Closing it requires making a choice before the celestial realm responds. Sect Leader, time is running out.'

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain composed. He examined the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact in his palm, where three paths materialized within the golden light: the first leading to the celestial gate, promising the strength and truth he sought; the second extending toward the artifact's sealed core, which might permanently seal this passage; the third channeling the artifact's energy to directly counter Cang Yutian. Mo Xiansheng murmured: 'Each path demands a price. Venturing into the celestial realm risks utter destruction, sealing the passage will drain your entire Heavenly Fate, and wielding the artifact...' He trailed off, yet the implication was unmistakable—it's a choice against heaven itself.

choice.prompt: The Turtle Shell Divine Artifact's radiance intensifies with each passing moment, and the rift in the celestial gate continues to slowly expand. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fixes his gaze upon you, awaiting your decision. Chen Nian's ethereal form flickers within the artifact, her vacant eyes holding what appears to be a glimmer of anticipation. At this critical juncture, you must make your choice—

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact erupted with unprecedented brilliance, engulfing him entirely. He felt an immense force tearing at his soul,眼前的景象飞速变换——九天之上的琼楼玉宇、缭绕的仙鹤祥云、还有那高坐于云端、面目模糊的至高存在……

text.content: Chen Ji bit through his tongue, spraying essence blood onto the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact. The artifact seemed to come alive, with countless symbols spreading from his fingertips and weaving into an impenetrable net. The celestial gate let out a deafening roar as that rift began visibly healing...

choices.visible_cost: May provoke total celestial retaliation, significantly increasing hostile forces
choices.visible_reward: Cang Yutian was severely wounded, Chen Nian's soul might gain liberation

text.content: A beam of jet-black light erupted from the Turtle Shell Artifact, carrying power sufficient to annihilate stars, striking directly at Cang Yutian's phantom. The old sect master's face revealed genuine terror for the first time: "No... you cannot..." Before the words finished, his figure was completely devoured by that darkness.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the Turtle Shell Artifact's reaction swept across the entire battlefield like a raging tide. Golden and black light intertwined, creating a surreal yet magnificent tableau. Han Lie struggled to rise from the ground, gazing at Chen Ji's back, feeling an unprecedented sense of powerlessness for the first time—who on earth was this person? Su Qingyao stood in the distance, her eyes flickering with complex emotions. Suddenly, she understood why Chen Ji had walked to today despite his useless reputation—he was never gambling with his life, but calculating it.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, a hint of cold indifference curving his lips. His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present: "You thought I was playing with fire?" He raised the Turtle Shell Artifact in his hand, golden light blazing in his eyes. "No, I'm only telling you—this chess game has always had only one Chess Player." As his words fell, the artifact violently trembled, and Cang Yutian's phantom let out a blood-curdling scream, beginning to disintegrate from its edges. The old sect master's true form seemed to endure identical agony across a distant realm, his voice fragmenting: "Chen Ji... you wait... the heavens will not forgive you..."

text.content: Just then, the sky suddenly darkened. Everyone looked up to see that the celestial portal, which had been gradually shrinking due to the seal, suddenly stopped healing. An indescribable pressure seeped from the depths of the portal—that was not power Cang Yutian could compare to—it was true Heavenly Might. Chen Nian's figure within the artifact trembled violently, her voice carrying unprecedented fear: "Brother, hurry... it's awakening... the Heavenly Celestial Eye... it's watching you!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul also issued a warning: "Sect Master, you cannot hesitate any longer! Once it locks onto you, nowhere in the Three Realms will you be able to escape!"

dialogue.content: Yet at this moment, Chen Ji fell into eerie stillness. He gazed down at the Turtle Shell Artifact in his palm, at his sister's faint figure within it, then suddenly smiled. That smile carried a sense of release, and also a resolve: "Nian'er, do you know? All these years I've been wondering—if I had been stronger back then, could I have protected you?" His voice was soft, yet it exploded in Chen Nian's heart like thunder. "Now I finally understand—whether I'm strong or not doesn't matter. What matters is..." he abruptly raised his head, his gaze sharp as a blade cutting toward the celestial portal, "whether I'm willing to challenge this so-called Heaven for all of you!"

text.content: The Turtle Shell Artifact seemed to sense Chen Ji's will, emitting a long, mournful cry. That sound pierced through the void, spreading across the entire Tianqing Sect, even reaching the three distant sects. Cang Yutian's phantom had mostly dissipated, yet he still made one final struggle: "You think a mere mortal can resist Heavenly Might? The Heavenly Celestial Eye has existed since the dawn of chaos—its will IS the Heavenly Way! You're nothing but an ant trying to shake a tree—" Chen Ji coldly interrupted him: "Ant?" He hurled the Turtle Shell Artifact into the air. The artifact floated above the Ninth Heaven, beginning to frantically absorb spiritual Energy from heaven and earth. "Then let this ant show you what it means—to reverse fate and change destiny!"

choice.prompt: The Turtle Shell Artifact floated above the Ninth Heaven, the celestial portal's rift no longer healing but beginning to expand. The Heavenly Celestial Eye's will was seeping through that crack, that pressure making everyone present feel suffocating. At this critical juncture, you must make the final decision—

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to touch the portal, a massive golden eye emerged from the crack. That eye held no emotion whatsoever, only cold, judging scrutiny. Chen Ji felt a vast power locking onto him, his body seemingly frozen in that moment. "Mortal, you have crossed the line." That voice did not come from Cang Yutian, but from a more distant, more terrifying existence—the Heavenly Celestial Eye itself.

choices.description: Burn your entire Heavenly Fate Value, transforming yourself and the Turtle Shell Artifact into a seal, permanently closing the celestial portal.
choices.visible_cost: May deplete your life force, bidding eternal farewell to your sister
choices.visible_reward: Completely sever the heavens' threat to the mortal realm, bringing ten thousand years of peace to the mortal realm

text.content: Chen Nian's figure drifted out from the Turtle Shell Artifact, transforming into a stream of light rushing toward Chen Ji. Her face was clear for the first time—it resembled Chen Ji's by seventy percent, tears hanging at the corners of her eyes: "Brother, don't! I don't want you to sacrifice yourself for me!" Chen Ji reached out wanting to touch his sister's cheek, only to find his hand passing through her figure—he no longer had enough life force to maintain physical form.

At this critical moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly turned to its final page. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out in alarm: "This is... the complete form of the Tianji Record! It's awakening at this moment!" On the yellowed pages, countless golden characters leapt like living beings, eventually converging into a world-shaking Great Dao truth—the character "逆". Simultaneously, the Turtle Shell Artifact's light intertwined with the Tianji Record, the two supreme treasures producing some mysterious resonance at this moment. A golden mark appeared at Chen Ji's Brow Center—that was the sign of the Tianji Record acknowledging its master, and also the beginning of his destiny-defying path.

The Heavenly Celestial Eye also seemed to notice this sudden change, that massive golden eye flickering for the first time. "Interesting." That voice rang out again, no longer entirely cold, carrying a hint of... amusement? "For ten thousand years, countless ants have attempted to challenge the heavens, most turning to ash at the first step. Yet you..." The Heavenly Celestial Eye's voice paused, "actually possess both the Tianji Record and this fragment. Very interesting, extremely interesting. Since that's the case, I shall grant you one opportunity—" Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted, knowing the true game had just begun. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Sect Master, it wants to play chess with you. The wager of this game is your life, and also... the fate of the entire mortal realm."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, a faint smile curving his lips. He slowly raised his head, directly facing that golden eye suspended above the Ninth Heaven, his voice calm yet carrying unshakable resolve: "Very well. Since Heaven wants to play chess with me, then let's play." His gaze swept across Su Qingyao and Han Lie behind him, and Ye Qing in the distant Demonic Path, his heart already calculating. "However, the wager cannot be paid by me alone. If Heaven wants to win, use all things in the mortal realm as the stake; if I win—" he paused, the Turtle Shell Artifact and Tianji Record simultaneously erupting with dazzling light, "I want you, Heavenly Celestial Eye, to return the justice this mortal realm is owed over these ten thousand years!" As his words fell, heaven and earth changed color, wind and clouds surged. Cang Yutian's phantom let out a final mournful cry in the distance, completely dissipating into the void. And that portal to the heavens actually slowly stabilized at this moment, neither expanding nor healing, as if truly transformed into a chessboard, awaiting both sides to place their pieces.

Just as the light emanating from the Turtle Shell Artifact gradually subsided, a blinding golden radiance suddenly blazed from the depths of the heavens. That light came from the other side of the celestial portal, as if something in the distant heavens was gazing at this side. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, the Tianji Record's foresight ability spazzing wildly at this moment—he saw a vast palace complex, saw countless kneeling figures, saw an eye even larger than the one before him, golden and enormous... that eye seemed to be reflecting his own figure. Mo Xiansheng's voice lingeringly sounded: "The Heavenly Celestial Eye's本体... it has finally noticed you. Sect Master, the true opponent in this chess game is not Cang Yutian, nor those ant-like existences—but that will standing high above since the dawn of chaos. Are you prepared?"
